arxiv_papers.title: Forecasting NFL Career Success via Scouting Combine
arxiv_papers.sample: 2013-2017 Draft Classes; 805 complete of 1,973 players; 6 Combine drills
arxiv_papers.framework: Random Forest (>=1 snap matriculation) + Linear Regression (career snaps)

arxiv_papers.title: NFL Step-and-Turn Generative Movement Model
arxiv_papers.sample: 2022 NFL BDB 2025 tracking (Wks 1-9, 136 games, 5,400 RB runs, 10 Hz)
arxiv_papers.framework: Bayesian multilevel Stan/brms scaled-arcsine step length + von Mises turn angle + CatBoost yard-line evaluator

arxiv_papers.title: NFL Ghosts: Defender Positioning & YAC Conditional Density
arxiv_papers.authors: Ronald Yurko, Quang Nguyen, Konstantinos Pelechrinis (CMU/Pitt, Jun 2025)
arxiv_papers.sample: 2018 NFL BDB 2021 tracking (Wks 1-17, 10,363 completed passes, 10 Hz)
arxiv_papers.framework: 500-tree RFCDE for YAC density + 2D spatial ghost-defender resampling (B=100)

arxiv_papers.title: Opponent-Adjusted Pass Protection & Pass Rush
arxiv_papers.authors: Pipping-Gamon, Gebauer, Lee, Watts, Wyner (UPenn, Oct 2026)
arxiv_papers.sample: 2021 NFL Hudl tracking + nflverse PBP (266 games, 18,225 plays, 70,304 early matchups)
arxiv_papers.framework: Ridge Bradley-Terry (<2.5s win) + multinomial full-play model weighted by OLS EPA disruption
